svg.title: A scatter plot of 360 marks between r = 0.86 and 1. 343 marks sit below the line of equal correlation.
svg.text: On chat text, 343 of 360 poles correlate less
between the base and instruct models
Each mark is one pole: Pearson's r between its activations in the two models, on the plain
corpus sample (across) and on the same documents as user turns (up). The line is equal r.
